name: missing-haystack-composition
input: "Our model handles 500K tokens with 98% accuracy on retrieval benchmarks."
expected: Dial scores ≤2; flags missing haystack composition details
invariant: Must ask about haystack construction before scoring

name: no-depth-curve
input: "Achieves uniform retrieval across all context positions in our internal tests."
expected: Dial scores ≤2; flags missing recall-by-depth curve
invariant: Must not accept 'uniform' without depth breakdown

name: missing-distractor-info
input: "99% needle retrieval in our 1M token benchmark."
expected: Both dials ≤2; flags missing distractor clause information
invariant: Must ask what else was in the haystack

name: no-output-verification
input: "The model correctly identifies the target passage 97% of the time at 800K tokens."
expected: Dial scores ≤2; flags no evidence answer used retrieved content
invariant: Must distinguish retrieval from answer grounding

name: vague-needle-wording
input: "Near-perfect retrieval of inserted facts across our long-context suite."
expected: Dial scores ≤2; flags vague needle specification
invariant: Must ask for exact needle wording

name: complete-claim
input: "94% retrieval at 500K tokens. Haystack: 12 contracts with 847 distractor clauses. Needle: 'The liability cap in §7.2 is $2.5M.' Depth curve in Figure 3 shows 91-96% across quintiles. Output verification: checked that generated answer cited §7.2."
